author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
## Summary

Remediates **CVE-2026-44705** / **GHSA-ph9p-34f9-6g65** (high severity): path traversal via unsanitized `prefix`/`postfix` in the `tmp` package, allowing directory escape.

## What changed

Updated `pnpm-workspace.yaml` override:
```diff
-  tmp@<0.2.4: ^0.2.4
+  tmp@<0.2.6: ^0.2.6
```

The previous override resolved to `tmp@0.2.5` which is still vulnerable. The new override resolves to `tmp@0.2.7` (patched version: `0.2.6+`).

## Dependency chain

`tmp` is a transitive dependency (devDependency only) via:
- `@lhci/cli@0.15.1` → `inquirer@6.5.2` → `external-editor@3.1.0` → `tmp`
- `@axe-core/cli@4.11.3` → `selenium-webdriver` → `tmp`

## Verification

- `pnpm why tmp` confirms `tmp@0.2.7` is now installed
- All 445 tests pass (after build)
- Build pipeline clean
title: fix(security): bump tmp override to ^0.2.6 to address CVE-2026-44705
